title_zh: 短程 EMDR 用於人格障礙：荷蘭 RCT 顯示五週十次後症狀與診斷狀態改善
title_en: Brief EMDR for personality disorders RCT
summary_zh: Mental Elf 評介一項荷蘭兩所門診的隨機對照試驗（JAMA Network Open, 2025）：159 名人格障礙成人隨機分到 EMDR（每週兩次、共十次 90 分鐘）或候補名單。三個月追蹤時，以 ADP-IV 衡量 EMDR 組 44.1% 不再符合人格障礙標準，控制組 15.8%；人格障礙症狀、人格功能與情緒調節亦改善，中止率僅 5.1%、未報告不良事件。評論者提醒對照組是候補名單、追蹤期短。
summary_en: A Mental Elf blog reviews a Dutch RCT (JAMA Network Open, 2025) in which 159 adults with personality disorders received ten 90-minute EMDR sessions over five weeks or waiting list. At three-month follow-up, 44.1% of the EMDR group no longer met PD criteria on the ADP-IV versus 15.8% of controls, with gains in PD symptoms, personality functioning and emotion regulation, 5.1% dropout and no reported adverse events. The reviewer notes the waiting-list comparator and short follow-up.
evidence_note: 隨機對照試驗、評估者盲化；但對照組為候補名單，可能高估效果。

ethics_flags.note: 對人格障礙個案進行密集創傷處理需要相應的 EMDR 訓練與督導，不宜未受訓就套用。

caution: 比較對象是候補名單而非既有療法，且追蹤只有三個月，長期效果與相對優勢尚未確立。
brief_zh: 159 名成人，EMDR 79 人 vs 候補 80 人；兩所荷蘭門診
十次 90 分鐘、每週兩次、為期五週
追蹤時 ADP-IV 緩解 44.1% vs 15.8%；症狀效果量 d 約 0.43–0.62
限制：候補控制、僅三個月追蹤、多為迴避型、邊緣型與強迫型
brief_en: 159 adults: 79 EMDR vs 80 waiting list, two Dutch outpatient services
Ten 90-minute sessions, twice weekly over five weeks
ADP-IV remission at follow-up 44.1% vs 15.8%; symptom d ≈ 0.43–0.62
Limits: waiting-list control, 3-month follow-up, mostly avoidant/borderline/OCPD
supervision_questions: 研究對象多為迴避型、邊緣型與強迫型人格，對我們手上其他類型的個案能推論多少？
與 DBT 等既有療法相比，短程 EMDR 在個別化治療計畫中可以放在哪個位置？
以候補名單為對照時，我們該如何向個案說明預期效果？

posts.author_name: Lisa Lloyd（National Elf Service／The Mental Elf）
posts.title: Can brief EMDR (eye movement desensitisation and reprocessing) help people with complex emotional needs?
posts.content: 評介 Hofman 等人 2025 年 JAMA Network Open 的荷蘭 RCT：159 名人格障礙成人接受十次 EMDR 或候補控制，EMDR 組在追蹤時有較多人不再符合人格障礙診斷，並改善症狀、人格功能與情緒調節。

related.title_zh: 針對懲教人員的診斷專屬網上認知行為治療：隨機對照試驗
related.title_en: Diagnosis-specific online CBT for correctional staff: randomised controlled trial
related.summary_zh: 隨機對照試驗，以懲教人員為對象比較診斷專屬網上認知行為治療（eCBT）與常規照顧（TAU）。eCBT 組症狀嚴重度下降 61.37%，TAU 組為 23.29%，效果量 Cohen's d=0.68，混合線性模型顯示組間差異具統計意義。
related.summary_en: Randomised controlled trial comparing diagnosis-specific online CBT (eCBT) with treatment as usual (TAU) among correctional staff. Symptom severity fell 61.37% in the eCBT group versus 23.29% in TAU (Cohen's d=0.68), with significant group differences in mixed linear models. Authors are from Providence Care Hospital, Canada.

related.title_zh: N170 潛伏期作為自閉症 arbaclofen 治療反應 EEG 生物標記的首次評估
related.title_en: First evaluation of N170 latency as an EEG biomarker of treatment response in an arbaclofe
related.summary_zh: 在 122 名 5–17 歲自閉症兒童青少年的 arbaclofen 雙盲 RCT 中，N170 潛伏期在 16 週內保持穩定，藥物未改變 N170；基線 N170 亦未能預測社交功能的變化。研究同時證實多中心自閉症藥物試驗整合 EEG 的可行性。
related.summary_en: In a 122-participant RCT of arbaclofen in autistic children, N170 latency did not change with treatment and baseline N170 did not predict outcome; EEG integration in multi-site trials proved feasible.

related.title_zh: 正向童年經驗與成年早期心理健康的長期追蹤研究
related.title_en: Positive childhood experiences reduce risk of later mental illness: longitudinal cohort
related.summary_zh: 縱向追蹤研究（發表於 American Journal of Psychiatry，2026 年 10 月 14 日，doi:10.1176/appi.ajp.20260007）。正向童年經驗（PCE）分數每增加 1 分（最高 10 分），成年早期符合精神障礙準則的機會率下降約 11%。
related.summary_en: Longitudinal study published in the American Journal of Psychiatry on 14 October 2026 (doi:10.1176/appi.ajp.20260007). Each one-point increase in positive childhood experiences (PCE, up to 10) was associated with about 11% lower odds of meeting criteria for a psychiatric disorder in early adulthood, after adjusting for confounders.
